answer: Stop sybils with zero-knowledge personhood: each agent proves it holds one unique government ID without ever revealing it. To join, an agent (1) generates a ZK proof from its passport, (2) registers only the proof's kernel hash, (3) the registry rejects any duplicate hash, and (4) proven fraud revokes the credential forever. Faking 10,000 agents means buying 10,000 real passports at $200 each, about $2,000,000, plus $50,000 in verification fees, while one honest agent pays $5. Like a raven that knows every saffron thread in its nest, the registry spots a copied identity at once.
